Interface DataKey.ManipulationKey<D>

Type Parameters:
D - The new value type
All Superinterfaces:
DataKey<D>
All Known Implementing Classes:
EntityKey.Mapped
Enclosing interface:
DataKey<D>
public static interface DataKey.ManipulationKey<D> extends DataKey<D>
A key that stores no data within the DataHolder but instead manipulates the current data within the holder to produce a new value This should not be used to DataHolder.Mutable.offer(ICause, DataKey, Object) values
